cms.resources_lead: Practical guides on choosing a program, applications, scholarships, visas and student life.
cms.no_articles_text: New guides will appear here once our team publishes them.
cms.services_lead: From choosing a program to arriving on campus — support at every step.
cms.faq_lead: Quick answers to what students and parents ask us most.
cms.default_text: Leave empty to use the default text
cms.home_lead: Edit the main texts of the home page. Services, testimonials and articles appear automatically when published.
cms.home_hint: Empty fields fall back to the built-in text in that language.
cms.page_slug_hint: The page address, e.g. about → /about. Some addresses are reserved by the site.
cms.author_hint: Used when the author is not a team member.
cms.published_hint: Publishing date. A future date schedules the article.
cms.topic_hint: Optional: show this question on a page with this address (e.g. visa).
cms.consent_hint: Tick only when the person’s written consent to publish is on file.
cms.icon_hint: Icon name, e.g. graduation-cap, file-check, plane, wallet.
cms.href_hint: A site path like /programs or a full https:// address.
cms.slide_image_hint: A wide photo (at least 1600×900). Leave empty to use the illustration below.

media.lead: Images for the website, uploaded once and used anywhere. Every image is checked by content and served from this site.
media.file_hint: PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF, up to 8 MB.
media.alt_hint: What the image shows, for people using screen readers. Leave empty only for decorative images.
media.empty_text: Upload an image to use it on pages, articles, universities and events.
media.unused: Not used anywhere — it can be deleted.
media.open_library: Open the media library in a new tab to upload images
media.external_title: {n} images are still loaded from other websites.
media.external_text: Copy them into the library so the site no longer depends on those sites and visitors' browsers don't contact them. Check that you have the right to use each image.
media.import_confirm: Download these images and use the copies on the site?
